sources.name: Department of Home Affairs - SkillSelect EOI statistics dashboard (Qlik app 'hSKLS02 SkillSelect EOI Summary Data_LIVE', last reload 2026-10-02T00:30:38Z), queried via the dashboard's public Qlik engine
Department of Home Affairs - SkillSelect invitation rounds

notes: All EOI pool figures are the dashboard's month-end snapshot for As At Month 09/2026 (i.e. as at 30 Sep 2026); history uses each month's snapshot.
Counts are distinct EOIs, not individuals (one person may lodge several EOIs; one EOI may select several subclasses).
Statuses: submitted = in pool awaiting invitation; invited = currently in INVITED status at the snapshot (not cumulative invitations); lodged/hold/closed as per SkillSelect.
491 combines the State/Territory Nominated (491SNR) and Family Sponsored (491FSR) streams, deduplicated by EOI.
null = count between 1 and 19, suppressed by Home Affairs (dashboard shows '<20'); 0 = no EOIs.
byOccupation.invited = EOIs in INVITED status across 189/190/491 for that occupation at the snapshot.
